notes.hardware-linux/peak_rss_mb: Ratcheted 120 -> 60 (FW-15, 2026-11-04). The audit's 150 MB predates the softbuffer CPU present: re-measured with examples/baseline under Xvfb (CPU path), peak RSS is 32 MB with 132 fonts and 32 MB with all 575 Noto faces installed; heaptrack puts the heap peak at 16.5 MB, the largest single allocation being the 840x600 Premul target (7.68 MB, 16 B/px). 60 leaves headroom for a Mesa Vulkan driver's mappings on the GPU path, which this sandbox cannot load; the next ratchet is toward AIMS' 40 once a self-hosted receipt records the GPU-path figure. A --record that moves this row up is a regression being written down, not a budget change.

gallery/00-layers-nested/cpu_p50_ms.reason: FW-07 known limitation, accepted 2026-10-21 (owner decision recorded in STATUS.md): the reference laptop (i5-7200U) misses the 16.7 ms / 60 Hz full-repaint budget by ~7 ms at p50 (receipt run 2026-10-15-kabylake-i5-7200u-linux; figures recorded here from it). What is left is memory bandwidth on 16-byte-per-pixel layers, and the fix that would close it — f16 layer storage — changes bytes, so it is held for the FIDELITY.md section-5 ruling rather than shipped silently. This entry keeps the drift gate honest: a regression past the recorded figure still fails the run. Remove it in the same commit as the win that brings this under target_ms (the check flags it stale).

gallery/23-editor-glass/cpu_p50_ms.reason: FW-07 known limitation, accepted 2026-10-21 (owner decision recorded in STATUS.md): the reference laptop (i5-7200U) misses the 16.7 ms / 60 Hz full-repaint budget by ~8 ms at p50 (receipt run 2026-10-15-kabylake-i5-7200u-linux; a retained repaint is already ~7.5 ms). Blur is ~12% of the remaining cost, and the fix that would close it — an SSE2 blur with a different accumulation order — changes bytes, so it is held for the FIDELITY.md section-5 ruling rather than shipped silently. This entry keeps the drift gate honest: a regression past the recorded figure still fails the run. Remove it in the same commit as the win that brings this under target_ms (the check flags it stale).

auto_first_frame_ms.reason: FW-16: the audit's mid-tier first-frame budget — 500 ms from launch to the first frame on any phone the app itself rates medium or high (its own tier choice, auto_cache_budgets). Low-tier phones (the LG Stylo 5 at ~640 ms) are reported, not gated; 120 Hz phones' pacing is a separate row. Measured 2026-10-30: iPhone 15 Plus 376, iPhone 18 Pro Max 280, Galaxy A36 437, Galaxy S26 Ultra 180.
